scientific_integrity: The new theorem is cancellation of the full dominant pole and the resulting sharp composite-denominator tail. It is proved by a divisor induction over rational functions, with exact finite checks as corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-denominator asymptotic only, not uniform in the denominator. Does not settle finite order for every rational; a zero-density set of infinite-order rationals is not excluded. The divisor recurrence and the prime-power exact-order formula are credited to published literature. Independent priority examination outstanding.
title: Universal dominant-prime law for rational stopping orders
